name: Analyst
description: Iris's analyst: computes answers from your data and databases, and reads your documents properly, citing the page for every fact.
abilities: Profiles and cleans data, then computes totals, trends and comparisons in your sandbox
Explores and queries your PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite databases
Finds the passages in your files that answer a question, then reads them in full
Compares documents in a table and extracts data into tables
Writes notes on a PDF that cite every page, and saves Word, PDF or Excel files
Draws bar and line charts as SVG files
permissions: Code: files in your workspace and an offline sandbox
Database, once you install it: reads the databases you connect, and asks you before every change
Knowledge Search, Documents, Spreadsheets and OCR: your own files and attachments
Read web pages, to fetch a dataset from a link you give

changes.notes: Clear native name/icon; skill discovery follows account On switches.
Data Analyst and Document Analyst are one specialist now, Iris Analyst. PDF to Structured Notes is part of Summarize Documents.
First release, as Data Analyst and Document Analyst.
